title: cli: give `settings` a registry-driven emitter in `i18n-extract.ts` — the one group the #14653 ruling says gets walked rather than ledgered
body:
Filed by the `domain:devx` execution seat (seat post #6023, session `session_012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`) **as the maintainer ruling on #14653 explicitly directs**: 「The devx seat files that card into the `domain:cli` queue (contract-first; no `Blocked-by:`)」.

## Provenance

- **Ruling:** #14653 comment `5522887332` — director seat, summon #11, 2026-09-03T08:29Z.
- **Who / verbatim / where:** maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-03, decision batch #18 item 4, adopting option **A**. Verbatim reply: 「同意」.
- ⚠️ This card was **not** filed when the ruling landed; the `domain:devx` shift that received it stood down at 10:32Z without discharging it. Filed at 10:58Z by the next sitter after confirming no duplicate exists (all open `domain:cli` cards enumerated; newest at the time of writing, #14895/#14894, both predate the ruling).

## What is ruled, verbatim from the ruling

> `settings` is walked: a registry-driven, config-independent emitter in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` over the settings manifests (the `walkMetadataForms` precedent; the fixture needs no change because the registry supplies the population).

## Why this is a `domain:cli` card and not a `domain:devx` one

The instrument that found the gap — the new gate `scripts/check-i18n-walk-parity.mjs` — is devx's and is built (PR #14763). Its **first measurement on `main` is red**: three groups declared by `TranslationDataSchema` have no emitter in `collectExpectedEntries`. Two of them (`messages`, `settingsCommon`) are ruled into the gate's shrink-only exemption ledger with their reasons, which is devx's half and stays on PR #14763's branch. **`settings` is the one the ruling says gets an actual emitter**, and the walker lives in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` — the lane seam triage named on #14653 up front (「写 cli 修复就是改道信号」).

## The measured basis (from the #14653 dev's per-group reading)

`settings` is keyed by `SettingsManifest.namespace`. The manifests are platform code (`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/*.manifest.ts`, with an aggregate export in the directory index), so they are **not** in `MetadataCategoryEnum` — but that is the same shape as `metadataForms`, and `collectExpectedEntries` already enumerates that one unconditionally via `walkMetadataForms`. ⇒ **There is a working precedent to copy, in the same function.** Because the registry supplies the population, this is config-independent and the existing fixture stack config needs no change.

## Executable acceptance criterion

`node scripts/check-i18n-walk-parity.mjs` (from PR #14763's branch, or on `main` once that PR lands) no longer reports `settings` among the declared-but-unwalked groups — with `messages` and `settingsCommon` remaining as the ledger's two authorised entries and **no third entry added as a bridge** (⛔ the ruling forbids that explicitly).

## Sequencing — no `Blocked-by:`, and this card is the one in front

Per the ruling: **PR #14763 stays `draft` until this emitter is on `main`.** So the dependency runs the other way from the usual seam — devx is waiting on this card, not the reverse, which is why the ruling says contract-first with no `Blocked-by:` on this side. Landing this unblocks the devx gate going ready → queue with its `lint.yml` step wired.

⛔ Out of scope here: the exemption ledger and `LEDGER_CEILING` (devx's half, PR #14763's branch); inventing key populations to reach green (option C, rejected as widening the walker's contract).

## Routing note for triage

`domain:*` is triage's field and this seat does not produce it, so the label is left unset deliberately — but the ruling names the destination lane in as many words (`domain:cli`). Sweep branch ② (`pm:queue`, no `domain:*`) should pick this up; please confirm `domain:cli` rather than re-deriving the routing from the title.
